headline: Continuity matters when a wrong fact changes the work.
lede: The useful boundary is not how much an agent can remember. It is whether the work needs a current, attributable, correctable record.

items.label: Trigger
items.title: A correction failed to travel
items.body: You fixed a value in one place and later discovered another agent still used the old one.

items.label: Trigger
items.title: You cannot explain an answer
items.body: The result matters, but nobody can show which source established it or when it changed.

items.label: Fit
items.title: You will run local infrastructure
items.body: You are comfortable installing and connecting a maintained tool, but do not want to build a state system from scratch.

items.label: Not a fit
items.title: Convenient recall is enough
items.body: The work has no shared state, no correction history, and no consequence when sources diverge.
